# Pour Vida Mobile Bar Services

> Dry-hire mobile bar and bartending service in Merced, Atwater, Madera, Chowchilla and Turlock, California. Established 2026. The client buys the alcohol; Pour Vida provides the bartenders, bar tools, setup and breakdown, and depending on the level, signature cocktails, mixers and garnishes. Events outside Merced and Atwater have a small travel fee.

## Events
Weddings, quinceañeras, birthdays, bridal and baby showers, corporate events, private parties.

## Packages (size by guest count)
- The Vida: 10 to 40 guests, best for small gatherings. 1 bartender, or 2 at the Signature level and up.
- The Amor: 41 to 75 guests, best for medium-sized gatherings. 2 bartenders.
- The Siempre: 76 to 120 guests, best for larger gatherings. 2 bartenders.

## Levels (available with every package)
- Essential: bartending service up to 4 hours, bar tools, setup and breakdown, cups, napkins and straws, basic garnishes, alcohol shopping guide. Client provides alcohol and mixers.
- Signature: everything in Essential plus 2 to 3 signature cocktails, custom drink menu, personalized menu signage. Client provides alcohol.
- Elevated: everything in Essential and Signature plus 3 to 4 signature cocktails, upgraded mixers and garnishes, bar styling to the event theme. Client provides alcohol.

Pricing varies with event details and is quoted per event.

## Cocktail menu (can be personalized)
Specialties: Elderflower Sour, Hibiscus Marg, Strawberry Limoncello Spritz.
Classics: Margarita, Whisky Sour, French 75, Espresso Martini.

## Booking
Book 3 to 4 weeks ahead. A 50% deposit holds the date after the proposal is approved.
